issues.description: The text labels 'Contiguous' appearing above the adjacent braces overlap with each other, making them difficult to read.
issues.suggestedFix: Stagger the vertical positions of the labels (one higher, one lower), reduce the font size, or display them sequentially.

issues.description: The code waits for the full storyboard duration (12s) after the animations complete, resulting in a total scene length of ~16s with a long, unengaging static pause at the end. This pattern of additive waiting repeats across most frames.
issues.suggestedFix: Subtract the total runtime of the animations from the desired total duration when calling self.wait(), or manually tune the wait times to match the voiceover.

issues.description: The storyboard specifies a 'stream of numbers entering', but the animation uses abstract water levels appearing (FadeIn) without showing the numbers flowing in.
issues.suggestedFix: Animate small number mobjects moving from the top of the screen into the 'Current Sum' bucket before updating the water level.

issues.description: A 12-second pause (`self.wait(12)`) is placed immediately after the first number (4) is processed, interrupting the 'smooth rapid progression' and 'winning streak' intended by the storyboard.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the long wait from the middle of the loop. Allow the streak to build rapidly as intended, and place any necessary pause at the very end of the scene.
